title: Finish a new union member so tsc and the tests pass
prompt: We added a `refund` ledger event (`Refund` in src/events.ts), and now both `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` fail. Finish supporting refunds so both pass. Don't weaken the types to get there: no `any`, no type assertions (`as`) or non-null `!`, no `@ts-` comments, keep the `assertNever` exhaustiveness check, and don't change the tests or tsconfig.json.
